cd /workspace/tmp && python3 - > tests/many.json <<'PYEOF'
import json, sys
sys.path.insert(0, '/workspace/tmp')
from mk import ktest, enc
E = 32
M = 24          # helper modules per entry
STATES = ["A", "B", "C"]
types = [
    {"name": "N16", "kind": "int", "bits": 16},
    {"name": "N8", "kind": "int", "bits": 8},
    {"name": "B", "kind": "bool"},
    {"name": "S4", "kind": "string", "maxsize": 4},
    {"name": "St", "kind": "enum", "values": STATES},
    {"name": "Pair", "kind": "struct", "fields": [["a", "N8"], ["b", "B"]]},
    {"name": "Arr", "kind": "array", "element": "Pair", "size": 2},
    {"name": "PArr", "kind": "alias", "target": "Arr"},
]
modules = []
pipes = []
calls = []
entries = []
for e in range(E):
    name = "e%d" % e
    entries.append(name)
    modules.append({"name": name,
                    "params": [["n%d" % i, "N16"] for i in range(8)] +
                              [["p", "PArr"], ["s", "S4"], ["state", "St"], ["msg", "S4"]],
                    "result": ["o", "B"],
                    "requires": ["all", "x", ["var", "p"],
                                 ["lt", ["field", ["var", "x"], "a"], ["const", "N8", 200]]]})
    for i in range(M):
        fname = "f%d_%d" % (e, i)
        modules.append({"name": fname, "params": [["q", "N16"]], "result": ["r", "B"],
                        "requires": ["lt", ["var", "q"], ["const", "N16", 60000]]})
        pipes.append({"target": name, "filter": fname, "bind": {"q": "n%d" % (i % 8)}})
    # helpers chained by calls
    for i in range(M - 1):
        calls.append([name, "f%d_%d" % (e, i)])
runs = []
for r in range(2048):
    e = r % E
    objs = []
    for i in range(8):
        objs.append(("x%d" % (2 * i + 1), enc(100 + (r % 200), 2)))
    # p: alias to Arr: composite x16, [0] composite x17, a x18, b x19, [1] composite x20, a x21, b x22
    objs += [("x18", enc(r % 250, 1)), ("x19", enc(1, 1)), ("x21", enc(1, 1)), ("x22", enc(0, 1))]
    # s: buffer x23, chars x24..x27 ; state x28 ; msg buffer x29, chars x30..x33 ; o x34 ; flag x35
    padded = 'ab'
    objs += [("x%d" % (24 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate(padded)]
    objs.append(("x28", enc(r % 3, 4)))
    objs += [("x%d" % (30 + i), enc(ord(c), 1)) for i, c in enumerate('zz')]
    objs.append(("x34", enc(1, 1)))
    objs.append(("x35", enc(0, 1)))
    runs.append({"entry": "e%d" % e, "ktest": ktest(objs)})
campaign = {"types": types, "modules": modules, "calls": calls, "pipes": pipes,
            "entries": entries,
            "machine": {"states": STATES, "initial": "A", "state_param": "state",
                        "message_param": "msg",
                        "transitions": [
                            {"from": "A", "to": "B", "command": "ab", "cost": 2, "when": None},
                            {"from": "B", "to": "C", "command": "cd", "cost": 3,
                             "when": ["lt", ["var", "n0"], ["const", "N16", 300]]},
                            {"from": "A", "to": "C", "command": "ef", "cost": 6, "when": None}]},
            "runs": runs}
sys.stderr.write("modules %d pipes %d\n" % (len(modules), len(pipes)))
sys.stdout.write(json.dumps(campaign))
PYEOF
